verdict.rationale: Guidance pages on www.sos.ca.gov were evidently retrieved: the pack quotes their content verbatim, and probes on that host returned ordinary 404s rather than a 403 or challenge. However, the bizfileOnline portal, which those pages direct readers to for document images, plain copies and search, serves an Incapsula bot-management SPA shell even at robots.txt, so part of the public reading surface is walled for keyless agents. Missing for 10: a hands-on fetch log confirming the guidance pages load with a standard identified UA and no JS or CAPTCHA, and bot-wall-free access to the bizfileOnline public reading surface.

support.subject: As an AI-native founder, the service's published guidance pages are reachable by a keyless agent with a standard identified user agent — no bot wall, JS-only shell, or CAPTCHA in front of the public reading surface

citations.quote: Welcome to bizfile California, the Secretary of State’s online portal to help businesses file, search, and order business records.
